stories.title: Houston in talks to host Essence Fest after New Orleans departure
stories.summary: The Essence Festival of Culture is leaving its longtime home of New Orleans after more than 30 years.

stories.title: Chilly Black Friday; Warmer this weekend
stories.summary: Gusty winds and chilly conditions are expected for Black Friday.

stories.title: Search underway for pregnant prisoner who escaped in corrections vehicle in New Mexico
stories.summary: A search was continuing in New Mexico on Thursday for a pregnant inmate who authorities allege escaped.

stories.title: FIFA says it has been victim of a cyberattack accessing 'personal and business information'
stories.summary: FIFA says it was the victim of a cyberattack.

stories.title: Heavy rain, wind, flooding hit much of US on Thanksgiving, snarling holiday travel

stories.title: Thanksgiving outings bring families to Cary as holiday shopping season approaches
stories.summary: Families across the Triangle found different ways to spend Thanksgiving together Thursday, with outings such as movies and ice skating.

stories.summary: Thousands without power in the Triangle after strong winds and downed trees.

stories.summary: The Durham Rescue Mission is preparing to serve more than 2,000 people during its annual Thanksgiving Feast.

stories.title: Necessities join gifts in Black Friday shopping carts as AI and higher costs steer spending
stories.summary: "Usually, when you think of holiday shopping, it's premium handbags and jewelry and those types of items, but we're fast seeing shoppers also use this season to stock up on the essentials," analyst Vivek Pandya said.

stories.summary: Bands from across the country are drumming up support to stay in New York City through the weekend for the now-postponed 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

stories.title: Young volunteers help feed thousands at Fayetteville Thanksgiving event
stories.summary: More than 100 volunteers helped serve a Thanksgiving meal to people in need, continuing a tradition that organizers say brings the community together.
